task.title: Switch editor mode
task.shortdesc: Move between Guided, All settings, and JSON for the same saved profile while using the compact shared profile context.

prereq.p: Open BPM in the browser and keep a profile, Library, All settings, Guided, JSON, or Compare surface available.

context.p: The compact shared context identifies the current profile by name, state, schema channel, and validation signal. Switching mode changes the editing surface, not the underlying saved profile; save unsaved changes before relying on another surface.

step.cmd: Confirm that the current profile is saved and has a visible ID.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Choose the target mode: Guided for common workflows, All settings for complete inspection, or JSON for raw document work.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Open the target mode and verify the compact context: profile name, state, schema channel, and validation signal.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Return to the previous mode only after saving or intentionally discarding changes.

info.note: Save or deliberately discard changes before leaving an editor, closing a tab, or confirming an irreversible action.

result.p: You are working on the same profile in the editor mode that fits the current task.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the visible state is unclear, stop editing, read the current status message, refresh once, and reopen the profile from the Library.
